articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: Bitcoin's volatility has plunged, but extreme price swings are more frequent than in 2018
articles.snippet: CoinDesk analysis finds 10 unusually large trading days in 2026, raising questions about how investors measure risk in an increasingly institutional crypto market.

articles.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
articles.snippet: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.

articles.title: BTC price support holds ahead of US CPI data: Three things Bitcoin traders need to know this week
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traders braced for inflation-based volatility after BTC price action preserved key weekly support around $82,500.

articles.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
articles.snippet: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.
